description: Source code for managing Batch documents in ERPNext, including batch creation, naming, validation, and stock quantity operations.

classes.name: Batch
classes.description: Represents a batch of items, with methods for autonaming, validation, and related operations.

classes.name: UnableToSelectBatchError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a batch cannot be selected due to insufficient quantity or other constraints.

methods.name: get_name_from_hash
methods.description: Generates a unique hash-based name for a batch.

methods.name: batch_uses_naming_series
methods.description: Checks if batch naming uses a series based on stock settings.

methods.name: _get_batch_prefix
methods.description: Retrieves the batch naming series prefix from stock settings.

methods.name: _make_naming_series_key
methods.description: Creates a naming series key based on a prefix.

methods.name: get_batch_naming_series
methods.description: Returns the batch naming series string if enabled.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Automatically generates a batch ID if not provided.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads additional item data such as image.

methods.name: after_delete
methods.description: Reverts the naming series if the batch is deleted.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the item has batch enabled.

methods.name: item_has_batch_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the item supports batch numbers.

methods.name: before_save
methods.description: Sets expiry date based on shelf life before saving.

methods.name: get_name_from_naming_series
methods.description: Generates a batch name from the naming series.

methods.name: get_batch_qty
methods.description: Returns the quantity of a batch in stock, optionally filtered by warehouse.

methods.name: get_batches_by_oldest
methods.description: Returns oldest batch and quantity for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: split_batch
methods.description: Splits a batch into a new batch, creating stock entries.

methods.name: set_batch_nos
methods.description: Automatically assigns batch numbers to outgoing items.

methods.name: get_batch_no
methods.description: Fetches a batch number using FIFO based on expiry date.

methods.name: get_batches
methods.description: Retrieves batches matching criteria, including serial number filtering.

methods.name: validate_serial_no_with_batch
methods.description: Validates serial numbers against batch association.

methods.name: make_batch
methods.description: Creates a new batch record if item supports batch numbers.
